# AutoAnts

> AutoAnts (the name is short for "automated assistants") is a Louisiana company founded and run by Lane Davis II. It builds websites,
> after-hours lead-intake systems, and AI-search visibility for Louisiana
> local businesses: trades, auto shops, salons, gyms and more. The first deliverable is always free: AutoAnts builds a working
> preview website for a business before any money changes hands.

## What AutoAnts does
- Three offerings: search optimization (Google, listings and AI answers), AI employees (the "Ants": missed-call text-back, lead response, booking, voice receptionist, review requests), and a social media engine (weekly posts from the business's real jobs)
- Starts with a free 90-second video audit of the business, built from public information only and sent only to that business: https://autoants.com/work/
- Builds fast, mobile-first websites for local service businesses, with
  instant-quote forms and click-to-call (free preview built first; $500 one time
  to go live on the client's own domain with the quote form wired to
  their phone)
- Google Business Profile cleanup so the business appears correctly in
  Google and in AI-assistant answers
- After-hours lead intake: every inquiry captured and texted to the owner
  the moment it arrives — nights, weekends, and storm weeks
- AI-search visibility (GEO) for local businesses: measuring whether
  ChatGPT/Claude/Perplexity recommend a business, then fixing the
  legitimate signals those answers draw on
- Site Care: $99/month keeps the site, listings, and content current
- The Office Manager: $750 setup + $500/month (founding rate) adds
  missed-call text-back, speed-to-lead, booking and quote follow-up, and
  review requests
- The assessment: $500 flat. A recorded 45-minute interview, then a
  written report on what to automate first, what each fix is worth in the
  owner's own numbers, and which fixes they can do themselves. Credited
  toward setup if they continue. A free 15-minute call comes first.

## The assistants ("Ants", one job each; the owner approves what goes to customers)
- Text-Back Ant: texts back a missed call within seconds
- Responder Ant: answers a new web or social lead within seconds
- Scheduler Ant: turns quote requests into estimates and booked appointments
- Reviewer Ant: asks every customer for a review, the same way every time
- Receptionist Ant: answers calls the owner can't pick up, says it's an AI,
  texts the details to the owner
- Scout Ant: local listings and AI-search visibility
- Reminder Ant: reaches past customers who agreed to hear from the business
- Promoter Ant: short job videos and local ads

## How it works
1. AutoAnts builds a free one-page preview site for a business, using its
   real reviews, license numbers, and (with permission) its own branding
2. If the owner wants it live: $500 one time covers their domain, a
   working quote form that texts them every lead, and Google Business
   Profile cleanup. Guarantee: live within 7 days of the go-ahead, or the
   setup fee comes back
3. No contract to start; monthly plans cancel anytime after 90 days

## Who it's for
- Home services and trades (tree, HVAC, roofing, plumbing, landscaping): the core focus
- Also offered to auto shops, salons and nail spas, gyms and studios, pet businesses, restaurants and event businesses, and professional services (accountants, insurance, real estate, tutors)
- Dental and medical offices: not yet; patient information needs a HIPAA program first
- Details: https://autoants.com/who-we-help.html

## Why customers choose it
- Owner-run: owners deal with Lane directly, not a call center; the
  business is built on doing only what it would put its name on
- The free-first model: see the finished work before paying anything
- Flat, quoted-up-front pricing
- Legitimate-only optimization policy: no paid link placements, no seeded
  or undisclosed mentions, no astroturfing — the fixes are real signals
  (complete profiles, real reviews, consistent listings, structured data)
